added.text: Wake Loop so our projector can come back to the Stage.
Join your friends at SparkFest. Find Loop, bring your paper story to life, and put on The Little Bridge.
SparkFest — stories and inventions made by us
There you are! Welcome to SparkFest. It's our festival of stories and inventions. Today, visitors are coming to see the story we made together.
This is Pip, our paper traveler. That's the red backpack you helped make. Our show is called The Little Bridge.
Pip promised to visit Grandma and plant a seed with her. But the river washed their bridge away. We still need to make the ending work.
You're running the show with us. Loop, our rolling projector, makes these paper characters move on the big screen.
I'm Remy. I made the little boats for our show. I was filming behind the scenes when I saw Loop leave.
You found us! I'm Ari. I record the moving paper scenes for our show.
The outdoor practice was canceled. The first public show is still planned.
Pip promised to plant with Grandma. They are still on opposite banks.
Welcome to SparkFest! Today, our crew is putting on The Little Bridge. We made the paper characters together. Now we need to bring their story to life on the big screen.
Pip crossed the river to reach Grandma. Together, they planted the seed in the hill's soil. A lantern-flower opened, and its warm light shone across the water.
Our premiere is the first public showing of The Little Bridge.
In rehearsal, we can try an ending and change it before the audience sees it.
The paper petals stay still indoors.
Pip and Grandma will plant the seed together.
